entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. Look, I'm busy, so let's just get this done. Can I return it or not?

Okay, pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on January 10th, which was 17 days ago. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, is there a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a preference issue?
It's not broken, it's just not what I wanted. It’s hard to use and frankly, a little confusing. I expected more from the interface.
I understand. Based on what you're describing, since the delivery was 17 days ago and it's a preference issue, the item is outside the 10-day return window for the VeloBand Pulse.
Ten days? That's it? I don't have time to learn a new device in ten days. What am I supposed to do now?

I can appreciate your frustration. While I can't process a refund, perhaps I can help with the issues you're facing. You mentioned the interface is confusing. What specifically were you trying to do that you found difficult?
The custom workout modes. I tried setting up intervals and it just wouldn't track them properly. The user manual was basically useless for that.

Ah, that's a common point of confusion, and I apologize that it wasn't clearer. You actually set up the interval structure in the VeloFit app first, under 'My Workouts.' Once you save it, you can start that specific workout directly from the band itself by swiping left twice on the main screen. The band will then give you haptic feedback for each interval change without you needing to look at it.
Wait, so I don't have to manually tap it every time? I can just pre-load the workout from the app?
Exactly. You set it up once on your phone, and the band handles the rest during your activity. It's designed to let you focus on your workout, not the tech.
Okay... that's... actually what I wanted it to do in the first place. That makes it much less of a hassle.
I'm glad to hear that! It's a powerful feature once you know where to find it. Is there anything else about the VeloBand I can help clarify for you?
No, that was the main problem. I'll give that a try. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
